Recordings trimmed and converted to mono MP3 for browser playback. Samples are used for a short original practice groove. Salsa Beat Machine was used as a reference for instrument choices; its recordings are not included.

September 2026 groove update
---------------------------
Piano replaced with eight close-mic forte Steinway B samples from VCSL (CC0):
Chordophones/Zithers/Grand Piano, Steinway B/Sus/JHPiano_Sus_Close_{C3,G#3,C4,E4,G#4,C5,E5,G#5}_vl4_rr1.wav
Files piano-48,56,60,64,68,72,76,80.mp3: silence trimmed, peak normalized, tail limited to 1.6 seconds, stereo MP3.
Playback uses short note envelopes, octave figures, inner thirds/fifths, a high-shelf presence boost and an original 2–3 montuno arrangement.

VCSL CC0 additions:
guiro-long: Idiophones/Struck Idiophones/Guiro/Guiro_Med_rr1_Mid.wav
guiro-short: Idiophones/Struck Idiophones/Guiro/Guiro_Fast_rr1_Mid.wav
bongo-muted: Membranophones/Struck Membranophones/Bongos/BongoH_HitMuted1_v2_rr1_Mid.wav
bongo-low: Membranophones/Struck Membranophones/Bongos/BongoL_Hit1_v3_rr1_Mid.wav

Sassaby, Freesound, all CC0. Public high-quality MP3 previews trimmed and normalized:

timbale-low: LP Matador Timbales Low (Hembra), https://freesound.org/people/Sassaby/sounds/533094/

Preview URL format: https://cdn.freesound.org/previews/533/{soundID}_2771755-hq.mp3
These are real instrument recordings, not drum-machine emulations.

Spoken count recordings: Jackson, Free Spoken Digit Dataset (FSDD), digits 1–8, index 0.
https://github.com/Jakobovski/free-spoken-digit-dataset
Original recordings: recordings/{digit}_jackson_0.wav
License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
voice-1.wav through voice-8.wav: silence trimmed, bandpass EQ, gentle compression, peak normalization and resampling. These adapted count files are distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0. Original natural speech pitch retained. Visible attribution is included in the inline Music settings under Sound credits.
The count recordings are human spoken numbers; the person did not record a salsa-specific instruction performance.

Original practice arrangement in groove.js:
2–3 son clave, conga tumbao, mambo cowbell, timbale rim pattern/fill, bongo martillo, güiro, alternating maracas, bass tumbao, two-bar piano montuno. Instrument changes mute stems without resetting the beat. Instructor calls the two breaks for the selected timing; roles share those break counts, with role-specific feet/directions and a stronger forward-break call.
